using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
const int N=250100;
int gi() {
	int w=0;bool q=1;char c=getchar();
	while ((c<'0'||c>'9') && c!='-') c=getchar();
	if (c=='-') q=0,c=getchar();
	while (c>='0'&&c <= '9') w=w*10+c-'0',c=getchar();
	return q? w:-w;
}
int mod,m;
int siz[N],inv[N];
struct DT{ int a[19]; }f[N];
inline int qpow(int x,int y) {
	int ans=1;
	while (y) {
		if (y&1) ans=1LL*ans*x%mod;
		x=1LL*x*x%mod;y>>=1;
	}
	return ans;
}
int main()
{
#ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
	freopen("CF838C.in","r",stdin);
	freopen("CF838C.out","w",stdout);
#endif

	for (i=0;i<18;i++) m+=n>>i&1;

		inv[i]=i<2?1:-1LL*(mod/i)*inv[mod%i]%mod;
		siz[i]=siz[i>>1]+(i&1);

			for (s=n;s;(--s)&=n)
				if (s>>i&1)
					for (a=0,F=&f[s^(1<<i)],G=&f[s];a<=m;a++) (G->a[a]+=F->a[a])%=mod;
	for (i=0;i<=n;i++) if ((i&n)==i) {
			F=&f[i];
			for (a=0;a<=m;a++) t[a]=F->a[a],F->a[a]=!a;
			for (y=k;y;) {
				if (y&1) {
					for (a=0;a<=m;a++) p[a]=F->a[a],F->a[a]=0;
					for (a=0;a<=m;a++)
						if (t[a])
							for (b=0;a+b<=m;b++)
								F->a[a+b]=(F->a[a+b]+1LL*t[a]*p[b])%mod;
				}
				if (y>>=1) {
					for (a=0;a<=m;a++) p[a]=t[a],t[a]=0;
					for (a=0;a<=m;a++)
						if (p[a])
							for (b=0;a+b<=m;b++)
								t[a+b]=(t[a+b]+1LL*p[a]*p[b])%mod;
				}
			}
		}

		if (n>>i&1)
			for (s=n;s;(--s)&=n)
				if (s>>i&1)
					for (a=0,F=&f[s^(1<<i)],G=&f[s];a<=m;a++) (G->a[a]-=F->a[a])%=mod;
	s=f[n].a[m];
